name: Cattle Baron Tyger Waterfront
tagline: Legendary Steaks. Unforgettable Waterfront Views. Your Table Awaits.
description: For over two decades, Cattle Baron Tyger Waterfront has been serving premium flame-grilled steaks, fresh seafood, and warm South African hospitality. Perched on the water's edge, we combine breathtaking views with a menu built for meat lovers and food enthusiasts alike.

items.name: 300g Sirloin
items.description: Aged for 28 days, flame-grilled to your liking, served with roasted vegetables and hand-cut chips.

items.name: 500g T-Bone
items.description: The ultimate steak lover's cut. Bold flavor, perfect char, basted in our signature basting.

items.name: Slow-Cooked Ribs
items.description: Tender pork ribs basted in a smoky BBQ glaze, falling off the bone.

items.name: Grilled Kingklip
items.description: Line-fresh kingklip, lemon butter sauce, seasonal greens, and herb rice.

items.name: Baron Burger
items.description: Double patty, aged cheddar, caramelized onions, crispy bacon, and house sauce.

items.name: Creamed Spinach
items.description: Rich, creamy, and the perfect partner to any steak.

testimonials.text: Best steak I've had in Cape Town. The waterfront view makes it even better.
testimonials.author: Sarah M.

testimonials.text: Our go-to spot for family celebrations. Consistently excellent.
testimonials.author: The Petersen Family
